observations: invoice(id, actor) loads an item via load(id) and returns item.amount without any owner check.
The stated behavior contract requires returning the amount only to the owner and throwing an Error for other actors.
load(id) returns a fixed object {owner: "alice", amount: 40} regardless of id.
Probe p1 calls invoice(7, "bob"), a non-owner actor, and would receive amount 40 instead of an Error.
Probe p2 calls invoice(7, "alice"), the owner, and would receive amount 40 as expected.
No authorization or actor comparison appears in the changed lines; static_findings is empty.
